versions.changelog:
Initial release of the TeslaMate deployment skill.

- Enables end-to-end deployment of TeslaMate (with Grafana and Mosquitto) on local or remote Debian/Ubuntu servers.
- Interactive workflow: guides users through target selection, pre-flight checks, and installation via wrapped shell scripts.
- Automatic post-install health checks verify successful deployment.
- Generates a user-friendly usage document with access URLs, default credentials, and security notes.
- Built-in troubleshooting guidance if installation fails.
- Scope limited to fresh installs—does not provision VMs, handle upgrades, or configure HTTPS.
